# Household notes

## Pets clause reminder

The lease says the tenant may keep up to two pets, provided they are
housebroken. A refundable pet deposit of 200 dollars applies per pet.
Check section 8 of the signed agreement before adopting a second cat.

## Rent

Rent is due on the first day of each month. The landlord accepts bank
transfers only; keep the confirmation emails in this folder.
